name: Three Sorrows of Ireland

attributes.attribute: three tragic tales of Irish myth

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Three Sorrows of Ireland are three tragic tales of myth. Each story ends in loss and grief. The first tells of the Children of Lir, who became swans. The second tells of a fated pair of lovers. The third tells of three brothers who failed a quest.

okr.objective: Set down the three tragic tales named the Sorrows of Ireland.
key_results: Names the story of the swan children
Notes that each tale brings grief
